# claude-code-zai

> Run Claude Code on the z.ai GLM Coding Plan (GLM-5.3, 1M-token context) on Linux, macOS and Windows. A one-command installer adds a separate `claude-z` command, z.ai's web search, web reader and vision MCP servers, a quota status line, and a `/zai-usage` command that works even when the quota is used up.

Key facts:
- Endpoint: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`, key in `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`.
- Models: `glm-5.3[1m]` (main, Opus, Sonnet, subagents) and `glm-5.3-flash[1m]` (Haiku). The `[1m]` suffix plus `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=1000000` fixes "Model glm-5.3 isn't recognized · context assumed to be 200k tokens".
- Claude Code's built-in WebSearch does not work through z.ai; use z.ai's web-search-prime and web-reader MCP servers.
- Quota: `GET https://api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit` (undocumented; Bearer key) returns 5-hour (unit 3) and weekly (unit 6) credit limits with `nextResetTime` in epoch ms.
- Error 1310 "Weekly/Monthly Limit Exhausted" = HTTP 429; the reset time in the message is UTC+8.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yel-hadd/claude-code-zai/v1.1.0/install.sh | bash` (Linux/macOS) or `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yel-hadd/claude-code-zai/v1.1.0/install.ps1 | iex` (Windows).

- Getting a plan: subscribe at https://z.ai/subscribe and create an API key. Invite links give new subscribers 10% off their first GLM Coding Plan order (z.ai campaign rules, October 2026). The author's referral link: https://z.ai/subscribe?ic=BY27XR8RLD (the author receives z.ai credits).
- Switching from a Claude subscription: `claude` keeps the Claude Pro/Max login; `claude-z` runs Claude Code on z.ai with separate settings and history, so both can be compared side by side.
